$comment: Machine-readable Sprint 5 plan. Prose rationale lives in specs/sprint-5-charter.md; this file is the shape delivery_loop_gate.py consumes. That script is NOT in this repo — it ships with the pm-skills plugin. Resolve it: PM_SCRIPTS=$(find ~/.claude/plugins -path '*/pm-skills/scripts' -type d -print -quit) then python3 "$PM_SCRIPTS/delivery_loop_gate.py" --plan specs/sprint-5-loop-plan.json --mode plan --output human. Sprint goal: board reconciliation + doc consolidation. Done when (A) board triaged, non-Done ≤ deliberate backlog and (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤14 governed docs. No code milestones — housekeeping sprint. WIP cap 3, 2 attempts/task, 6 iterations. Reviewer: claude-review.yml only (no /codex).
goal: Board reconciliation + doc consolidation. Done when: (A) board triaged, non-Done ≤ deliberate backlog; (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤14 governed docs. PLZG Sprint 5.

tasks.title: Fetch and reconcile against origin/dev before any other task runs
tasks.note: Blocking precondition, exempt from the attempt cap. No Jira ticket: it is a precondition the SessionStart hook already runs.

tasks.title: Transition 6 false-WIP items to Done (PLZG-221, -215, -209, -200, -199, -180)

acceptance.cmd: source .env && curl -s -H "Authorization: Basic $ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_BASE64" "https://$ATLASSIAN_URL/rest/api/3/search?jql=project%3DPLZG%20AND%20status%3D'In%20Progress'%20AND%20key%20in%20(PLZG-221%2CPLZG-215%2CPLZG-209%2CPLZG-200%2CPLZG-199%2CPLZG-180)&fields=key,status" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["total"]==0, f"{d["total"]} still In Progress"'

tasks.note: These 6 items are false-WIP: work already merged but tickets still In Progress. Transition each to Done via the Jira API.

tasks.title: Three-bucket triage of To Do backlog (Done/Keep/Won't Do)

acceptance.cmd: echo 'Manual verification: every To Do item reviewed and bucketed'

tasks.note: Review every remaining To Do item. Bucket as Done (already merged), Keep (real remaining work), or Won't Do (stale/duplicate). Do not bulk-close — review each individually.

tasks.title: Ungovern tier-4 docs + mark Sprint 2/3 charters HISTORICAL (27→≤14)

acceptance.cmd: python3 scripts/validate_specs.py 2>&1 | grep -oP '\d+ governed' | grep -qP '^(\d|1[0-4]) governed'

tasks.note: Move tier-4 docs (summaries, research) from documents to exempt in doc-registry.json. Mark Sprint 2 and Sprint 3 charters HISTORICAL. Grep D-nnn before ungoverning any doc. Target: ≤14 governed docs.

tasks.title: Cross-check surviving docs for state contradictions

acceptance.cmd: echo 'Manual verification: no state claims contradict CLAUDE.md or git history'

tasks.note: After T3 reduces the governed set, read each surviving doc and verify its state claims against CLAUDE.md and git log. Record any contradictions found and fix them.

tasks.title: Sprint 5 charter (specs/sprint-5-charter.md), loop plan, Jira sprint creation on PLZG board

acceptance.cmd: python3 scripts/validate_specs.py && test -f specs/sprint-5-charter.md && test -f specs/sprint-5-loop-plan.json

tasks.note: Charter, loop plan, and doc-registry.json update in one PR. Jira sprint 51 created on PLZG board 169 (company-managed Scrum). PLZG-234 is a duplicate of this ticket — created during batch ticket creation, use PLZG-229 as T5.

tasks.title: Sprint close — both gates green

acceptance.cmd: python3 scripts/validate_specs.py && echo 'Gate B: validator green' && echo 'Gate A: board triaged (manual)'

tasks.note: Procedural close. Both gates must pass: (A) board triaged, (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤14 docs. Update charter status to COMPLETED. Run delivery_loop_gate.py --mode close.
